name: Bulwark
overview: The concept of a bulwark in Scripture illustrates both physical and spiritual protection. In Deuteronomy and Ecclesiastes, bulwarks are described as defensive structures built against enemies during warfare, emphasizing God's provision of safety and security. Psalm 48 calls believers to recognize and remember these protective walls, while Isaiah 26 portrays salvation itself as God appointing walls and bulwarks, highlighting His role as the ultimate defender of His people.
